headline: Weathered Expanse Flares Anew as Northern Sectors Sustain Heavy Clashes
war_summary: Combat has reignited with severe intensity across Weathered Expanse, where eleven base transitions over the past two hours and sixty-one across the full day have left the sector fractured between Warden holdings, Colonial positions, and contested no-man's-land around Wightwalk and Crow's Nest. Mooring County remains a primary pressure point, logging four fresh base events and over seven hundred casualties in the last two hours as struggles continue near Gravekeeper's Holdfast. Callahan's Passage has also broken its recent lull, registering three base transitions in two hours focused on Crumbling Post. Along Nevish Line, territorial lines held firm over the last six hours even as infantry engagements inflicted seven hundred combined casualties in the latest two-hour window. Peripheral theaters including Palantine Berm, Kuura Strand, and Fisherman's Row have settled into relative quiet following earlier exchanges, concentrating active territorial disputes along the northern frontier.
